summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Amer Sports, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 14, 2026. The filing discloses the re-election of four directors (Bruno Sälzer, Dennis J. Wilson, Kin Wah Stephen Yiu, Jie Zheng) for three-year terms and the ratification of KPMG LLP as the independent auditor for fiscal year 2026. The item is a routine administrative update; no special-situations event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. This is a routine current report that does not fall into any special-situation category.
